findings.title: z_reports.id=2 signature_mismatch — verify-chain --all + assert-chain-clean BOTH return exit 1 on current branch HEAD

evidence.chain_break_NOT_chain_continuity: Z#2.prev_hash (504a44c0e17b71dd) DOES equal Z#1.signature (504a44c0e17b71dd) — chain_continuity intact. Sequence_no=2 immediately follows Z#1.sequence_no=1 — NO gap. Only the HMAC signature itself does not recompute.

findings.likely_root_cause: Z#2 was opened+closed empty in the SAME second (14:12:43) by a manual/test trigger (opened_at = closed_at = 14:12:43) but created_at + updated_at on the row are 16:12:43 (~2h later). This timestamp drift is consistent with the Z#2 row being either (a) inserted via a non-service path bypassing the sealing pipeline, or (b) the close() ran during a transaction that rolled back the signature compute but persisted the close — extremely rare race window, NOT reproduced.
findings.production_impact: DEPLOY BLOCKED. scripts/deploy/pre-flight.sh would exit 1 on this state. scripts/deploy/deploy-hetzner.sh remote check would halt cloud cut-over. soak-tick.sh monitor would tail TAMPER line.
findings.v1_local_le_cayenne_impact: V1 LOCAL operation continues (the seal failure is a forensic break for the empty Z#2, NOT a corrupt revenue Z — total_ttc=0, order_count=0). However the next Z open() call will FAIL because ZReportService::open():88 calls verifyChain() and BOTH the legacy verifyChain() (defaults to strict=true in production) and chainValidator()->assertChainIntegrity() will throw on a known breach. Operator-visible.
recommended_action: 1. CONFIRM via diff vs git history whether Z#2 was inserted by a test/fixture path bypassing ZReportService::open()+close(). Inspect git log on tests/ + database/seeders/ touching z_reports between 2026-05-27 14:00 and 14:30.

2. If test-fixture origin confirmed: hard-delete Z#2 (requires BYPASS of the BEFORE DELETE trigger on z_reports — see migration 2026_05_09_160000 + ansible REVOKE on prod) — DEV ONLY. NEVER on production.
3. If real-race origin confirmed: open a P0 lock-plan against ZReportService.close() to study the rollback-without-signature race + add a post-commit assert(verifySignature) hook.

4. SHORT-TERM: gate any current deploy attempt — pre-flight.sh + deploy-hetzner.sh + assert-chain-clean correctly catch this. DO NOT attempt to manually fix the signature in DB (that IS the tamper everyone is trying to detect).

findings.title: Cross-midnight 2-min dead-zone window (23:59 close → 00:01 open Paris) — orders created in this 120-second residual interval risk NOT being aggregated into either Z

evidence.kernel_comment_kernel_php_line_403_405: GAP-HUNT 2026-05-25 PROPOSAL-Z-LOOP-GAP Path A: orphan-window shrinks ~10 min → ~2 min residual. Path B (business_date SSOT) deferred.
evidence.aggregate_window_semantics: ZReportService::aggregate uses half-open (from, to] on created_at. close at 23:59 → to=23:59:00. open at 00:01 → next Z opened_at=00:01:00 → next close's from=00:01:00. Orders with created_at IN [23:59:01, 00:00:59] fall in NEITHER window.
evidence.compensating_warn: ZReportService::warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders is called at close() to surface kiosk-paid orders missing fiscal_seq, but it does NOT surface orders with fiscal_seq landing in the dead-zone between close+open windows.

findings.production_impact: An order created at 23:59:30 Paris with fiscal_sequence_no allocated would: (1) HAVE a receipt printed with valid seq_no, (2) NOT be counted in J Z aggregate (created_at > 23:59:00 to-bound), (3) NOT be counted in J+1 Z aggregate (created_at < 00:01:00 from-bound). The chain remains intact (signature does not cover the missing order), but NF525 'every receipt in exactly one Z' invariant breaks for that ~2-minute window per day per branch.
findings.v1_le_cayenne_real_world_risk: LOW for Le Cayenne single-resto FR (typical fermeture 23:00, cashier closes Z manually before 23:30, cron is safety-net only). HIGH for V2 SaaS 24/7 dark-kitchen or late-night chains where 23:59 is peak hour.
recommended_action: 1. V1 owner-mitigation: add operational rule 'no kiosk orders after 23:55 Paris' OR cashier closes Z manually before 23:55 (defer cron entirely on busy nights).

2. V1.0.X PATH B HEAL: rebound Z aggregate to use business_date SSOT instead of created_at. Comments document this is deferred behind a LOCK — verify the LOCK doc exists. Effort estimate ~1-2 days dev + sentinel + chain-replay migration.
3. SHORT-TERM intermediate: shrink the residual to ~0 by switching close at 23:59:55 + open at 00:00:05 (10-second window only). Path A iteration variant explored in GAP-HUNT 2026-05-25 — owner-gate.

findings.kind: CODE OBSERVATION — Orders allocate fiscal_sequence_no even when no Z is open
findings.title: 9 live orders (#75-85, fiscal_seq=4-12) hold an allocated fiscal_sequence_no but Z#2 is closed and no Z is currently OPEN

evidence.live_state: 0 OPEN z_reports on branch=1, 9 orders with fiscal_seq_no NOT NULL created AFTER Z#2.closed_at (14:12:43). FiscalSequenceService is decoupled from ZReportService — it allocates a counter regardless of Z status.
evidence.decoupling_rationale: FiscalSequenceService PHPDoc lines 14-33 — seq_no is a per-branch monotonic, gap-free counter. Z report is the aggregate. The two are independent by design; this is the documented pattern.
code_paths: app/Services/Fiscal/FiscalSequenceService.php:57-114 next() — only depends on Order::max('fiscal_sequence_no') for the branch, NO Z dependency
app/Services/OrderService.php posOrderStore (and equivalent kiosk paths) call FiscalSequenceService::next() without checking ZReport STATUS_OPEN

findings.production_impact: Orders are LEGAL (receipt issued with seq_no) but UN-AGGREGATED until next Z open + close. At Z close, ZReportService::aggregate's window (open.opened_at, closed_at] will NOT include these orders because their created_at < new open.opened_at. They become PERMANENTLY EXCLUDED from any future Z — same root cause as Finding 2 dead-zone but persistent (not 2-min window).
recovery_options: Option A: manually open a new Z with backdated opened_at = Z#2.closed_at = 2026-05-27 14:12:43, then close it with closed_at = now() — this would absorb all 9 orders. Requires temporary override of ZReportService::open() which uses Carbon::now() hardcoded for opened_at (line 119).

Option B: V1.0.X HEAL — when ZReportService::open() detects orders with fiscal_seq_no in the gap since prev_close, auto-backdate opened_at to prev_close.closed_at. Effort: medium, frozen-zone touch with LOCK required.
findings.recommended_action: V1 single-resto LOW immediate impact (operator visibility via daily Z totals discrepancy will surface this on the next close). Owner-gate: decide manual recovery now (Option A backdate) vs accept loss + V1.0.X HEAL (Option B).
